decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program draws on the firm's existing production and logistics know-how. Its delivery results are easy to read and learn from, though it may later be folded into the broader express line D.

The 72-hour program builds on established manufacturing and spare-parts logistics. It is only mentioned on the website and is operationally demanding, so it carries a higher risk of consolidation, but it still fits the firm's fast-response strategy.

The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the firm's core Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system and was promoted on the home page. It sits squarely within the firm's own R&D and certification expertise.

This multi-model express line has its own page and draws on core competencies in production and logistics. It serves as the umbrella for the firm's fast-delivery offering, which makes it a durable product.
The online ordering platform supports trade partners and the firm's service-oriented strategy. Usage data from it is easy to absorb and act on, so it is worth continuing to develop.
The fire and smoke protection door is a core competency backed by certification and in-house engineering. Products like this are typically kept long term.
